description: Build the GB Carbon Intensity Forecast project page at carbon-intensity.james-westwood.dev. A long-scrolling portfolio page with a live P10/P50/P90 forecast widget, architecture diagram, real Plotly explainability charts, and stack/source links. Design system and prototype provided in the design handoff zip.
design_reference: ~/Downloads/GB Carbon Intensity Forecast.zip — extract to review prototype
quality_checks: npx lighthouse https://carbon-intensity.james-westwood.dev --output json | jq '.categories | {performance: .performance.score, accessibility: .accessibility.score, best_practices: .["best-practices"].score}'

tasks.title: site_scaffold
tasks.description: Scaffold Astro project in ~/Programming/personal/james-westwood/. Use plain CSS (no Tailwind) to match the design system which uses CSS custom properties. Configure Netlify: netlify.toml with `[build] command = 'astro build' publish = 'dist'`. Set up custom subdomain carbon-intensity.james-westwood.dev pointing to Netlify deploy. Create the page at src/pages/carbon-intensity.astro.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Astro dev server runs. `astro build` succeeds. Netlify deploy preview accessible at a *.netlify.app URL.

tasks.title: design_tokens
tasks.description: Copy design/styles/tokens.css verbatim into src/styles/tokens.css. Copy design/styles/page.css into src/styles/carbon-intensity.css. Import both in the carbon-intensity.astro page. Add Google Fonts preconnect and import for Inter Tight (400/500/600/700) and JetBrains Mono (400/500/700). Set <body data-accent='sdg-7'> on the page. Copy design/assets/logo.svg and favicon.svg to public/assets/.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Browser devtools confirms --accent is #FCC30B on the page. Inter Tight and JetBrains Mono load. favicon.svg shows in tab.

tasks.title: static_sections
tasks.description: Build all non-interactive page sections as static Astro markup: (1) sticky header with wordmark jw.dev + 4 nav links; (2) hero band with breadcrumb, H1, lede, SDG-7 badge, dotted-grid background; (3) architecture diagram (5 arch-nodes + 4 chevrons + metadata strip); (4) explainability section shell with 3 chart-card placeholders (no Plotly yet); (5) stack section with 15 stack-tag chips and links-card with 4 rows; (6) footer (3 columns + bottom bar). Port markup and CSS from the design prototype exactly. The widget can be an empty .widget div for now.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All sections render at 1280px matching the prototype. No layout shift. Mobile collapses correctly at 980px and 600px breakpoints.

tasks.title: api_cors_get_endpoint
tasks.description: Add GET /forecast endpoint to the Cloud Run API (energy-forecasting/src/api/routes/forecast.py). Accept horizon as query param: GET /forecast?horizon=4 (default 4, ge=1, le=48). Response shape: {generated_at: ISO string, horizon_periods: int, settlement_period_minutes: 30, points: [{t: ISO string, p10: float, p50: float, p90: float}]}. Add CORS middleware to src/api/main.py: fastapi.middleware.cors.CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=['https://carbon-intensity.james-westwood.dev', 'http://localhost:4321'], allow_methods=['GET', 'POST']. Rebuild and deploy to Cloud Run.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: curl 'https://forecast-api-719697349745.europe-west1.run.app/forecast?horizon=4' returns 200 with points array. Browser fetch from localhost:4321 to Cloud Run does not get a CORS error.

tasks.title: widget_live
tasks.description: Build the live forecast widget as an Astro island (client:load). Port the toolbar, quantile cards, SVG chart, and footer chips from the design prototype's forecast.js. Replace canned SERIES data with a real fetch to GET /forecast?horizon={h}. Behaviour: (1) on mount, set status pill data-state='loading', fetch, set 'ok' or 'error'; (2) cache response for 60s — skip fetch if last response is < 60s old; (3) show skeleton (opacity 0.4 pulsing) on quantile cards and chart area during load; (4) on horizon button click, update aria-pressed, re-fetch (or use cache if fresh), re-render SVG; (5) timeout at 5s → error state. Keep the Catmull-Rom smoothing from forecast.js. The last refreshed timestamp updates after every successful fetch.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Widget shows real P10/P50/P90 values from the API. Horizon buttons switch data. Status pill shows green steady dot. Skeleton shows on first load. Error state shows red dot if API unreachable.

tasks.title: sticky_header_scroll
tasks.description: Port the page.js scroll handler into the Astro page (inline <script> or client:load). Toggle data-scrolled='true' on #siteHeader when window.scrollY > 8. Animate border-color over 200ms via CSS transition on [data-scrolled='true']. Mark the current page nav link with aria-current='page' to get the permanent accent underline.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scrolling past 8px shows the 1px --border-1 bottom border on the header with a smooth 200ms transition. No border at top of page.

tasks.title: plotly_explainability
tasks.description: Replace the three placeholder chart-card SVGs with real Plotly figures. (1) Export feature importance, calibration coverage, and pinball-loss-vs-horizon charts from energy-forecasting/src/models/forecasting/ using plotly.io.to_html(fig, full_html=False, include_plotlyjs=False). Save to energy-forecasting/docs/plotly/. (2) Load Plotly.js basic bundle once via CDN <script> in <head>. (3) Embed each chart's HTML div inside the corresponding .chart-card. (4) Match colours from the design spec: --accent #FCC30B, P10 #4FD1A1, P90 #F47B60, bg #10161D, axes #7D8B9B, grid #1E2630. Paper and plot bgcolor must be transparent to inherit card background.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All three Plotly charts render in the browser with correct colours. Feature importance uses real SHAP gain values. Calibration uses real empirical coverage. Residuals uses real pinball loss by horizon.

tasks.title: a11y_pass
tasks.description: Accessibility and motion pass: (1) Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to carbon-intensity.css — disable status-pill pulse, set all transition durations to 0ms. (2) Add :focus-visible outlines using --shadow-focus (2px offset, 2px solid --accent) to all interactive elements: horizon buttons, nav links, links-card anchors. (3) Verify all horizon buttons are real <button> elements with aria-pressed. (4) Verify API status div has role='status'. (5) Verify all SVG charts have aria-label. (6) All links-card <a> open in new tab with rel='noopener'.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tab navigation reaches every interactive element in logical order. Focus ring visible on all interactive elements. No pulse animation when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce. axe browser extension reports zero violations.

tasks.title: deploy_and_lighthouse
tasks.description: Final deploy and quality pass: (1) Point DNS CNAME carbon-intensity.james-westwood.dev → Netlify deploy URL. (2) Confirm HTTPS. (3) Update all placeholder # hrefs in the links-card to real URLs: GitHub repo, OpenAPI endpoint, ESO carbon intensity API, training notebook on GitHub. (4) Inject build date into footer 'last deployed' line at Astro build time. (5) Run Lighthouse against the live URL and fix until Performance ≥ 95, Accessibility ≥ 95, Best Practices ≥ 95. (6) Verify page renders correctly with JS disabled for all sections except the widget island.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: carbon-intensity.james-westwood.dev loads over HTTPS. Lighthouse: Performance ≥ 95, Accessibility ≥ 95, Best Practices ≥ 95. Page renders with JS disabled except the widget.
